long_biography.plain_text:
Koltes began his career at Citibank in corporate finance, working in New York, Zurich and London before joining Citicorp Venture Capital's European operation. In 1993, he and colleagues completed a management buyout that created the independent CVC Capital Partners. He led the German-speaking business, later joined CVC's global executive leadership and became co-chair, building wealth through founder ownership and private-equity economics rather than through ownership of portfolio-company assets.

Koltes left active management in 2022 and is now CVC's honorary co-chair and a non-executive board member. He also serves as founding director of Kaltroco, a family-owned investment company that deploys permanent balance-sheet capital into private businesses. His disclosed CVC shareholding and Kaltroco investments are personal or family interests. CVC's assets under management belong to its funds and clients, while operating assets remain with the underlying portfolio companies.
